title: Staged priming‑less hotpatch validator with probationary traffic gating for VPC runtimes
creator: Ava Chen
description: Objective: enable zero-downtime hotpatches to the private (VPC) data-plane runtime without mandatory prepriming by using incremental snapshot checkpoints, a probationary traffic gate, and lightweight health validators. This ticket implements the automation (Terraform + controller tasks + runbook) that: 1) creates on-demand immutable snapshots (memory and KV checkpoint) before patching a slice; 2) performs a lightweight behavioural validation (fast synthetic traces + tail-latency checks + KV-consistency smoke tests) on a small set of instances; 3) opens a probationary traffic gate for a bounded % of real tenant traffic for N minutes with strict SLO thresholds; 4) progressively increases traffic while running live canary checks and rolling back automatically on failure conditions. The solution avoids expensive global cache re‑priming by relying on snapshot-led reconcilers and short-lived probationary routing that allows the system to warm KV caches under production load in a controlled way.
comments: 2026-02-18 - AC: Created initial proposal and proposal doc in Drive. Key constraints: avoid mandatory full-priming, keep rollback time under 90s, KMS-integrated snapshot metadata.
2026-02-23 - MO: Spike completed for snapshot export format (kv+session-index). Found minor race when exporting live slices under heavy evictions; added a short quiesce window (200ms) in exporter.

2026-03-01 - PO: Review with Product; accepted probationary traffic gating concept but asked for clear escalation steps and customer notification hooks in case of rollback. Added notification label to runbook.
2026-03-04 - SE: Terraform module draft pushed. Module creates aws_ec2 patch instances, snapshot bucket objects, and an IAM role for the snapshotter. PR: link in attachments.

2026-03-07 - QA: Synthetic trace harness added. Runs 120 requests across 8 flows (short/long context, embeddings fetch, kv-read/write) and asserts p99 latency < 300ms, error rate < 0.2%. Tests now part of CI gate before probationary open.

2026-03-09 - MO: Implemented probationary router controller: accepts policies {initial_pct, step_pct, max_pct, step_duration, rollback_thresholds}. Currently default initial_pct=1, step_pct=5, step_duration=10m.
2026-03-10 - AC: Security review requested. Note: snapshots include metadata only (no plaintext customer prompts). KMS key policy proposal attached to PR.
runbook_summary: Preflight: terraform plan + snapshot dry-run; Stage 0: create snapshot and spin new runtime nodes in isolate mode; Stage 1: run validator suite (synthetic + kv smoke); Stage 2: open probationary gate at 1% for 10m; Stage 3: step up traffic in 5% increments every 10m until 50% then 100%; Failure: immediate rollback to snapshot and route all traffic to previous generation; Postmortem: collect metrics and automatic issue template.
acceptance_criteria: Automation creates an immutable snapshot and stores manifest in S3 with KMS encryption
Validator suite passes in CI for patched runtime images
Probationary router opens at configured initial_pct and obeys step policy
Automated rollback triggers when any threshold exceeded: p99 latency regression > 25% or error rate > 0.5% over a 5m window
Runbook test: simulated failure causes rollback within configured RTO (<120s) and operator notifications generated
implementation_notes: Terraform changes are isolated in modules/patcher_v2. Key resources: module.patch_snapshot (creates s3 objects, kms alias), module.probation_router (lambda controller + route53 weighted policies), module.validations (ci hooks + test runner). Controller uses leader election to avoid double-open. Snapshot format v2 is backward compatible with existing restore paths.
manual_steps_for_staging: 1) terraform apply -var='env=staging' modules/patcher_v2; 2) upload test image to staging registry; 3) trigger controller with --dry-run=false and watch staging dashboard; 4) run synthetic suite from qa-runner; 5) if green, start probationary gate at 1%
post_deployment_checks: metric: runtime.request.p99 (compare to baseline; fail if >25% deviation)
logs: exception spike > 50 in 5m triggers alert
traces: tail-sampling for errors to Sentry and link to runbook
